name: f3-request-mldr-pilot
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun recovery-input/materialize.ts; bun recovery-input/compose.ts requests; bun request-input/pilot-source.ts; result=0; bun f3-input/pilot.ts > request-f3.log 2>&1 || result=$?; cat request-f3.log; test "$result" -eq 0; bun request-input/pilot-source.ts request-f3.log; bun f3-input/audit-pilot.ts request-f3.log --strict-window
